nodes.label: Never use next/font/google (build-hang gotcha)
nodes.rationale: Switching the Geist fonts to next/font/google fetches font files over the network at build time; on this network-constrained machine it makes next build / next dev hang indefinitely at 0% CPU with no error output, and it's hard to diagnose since nothing prints to the log. Fonts must stay on the local geist npm package (geist/font/sans, geist/font/mono) instead.

nodes.label: Multipass/VM RAM contention build-stall gotcha
nodes.rationale: Builds/type-checks can silently stall for minutes at ~0% CPU (not fail, just hang) when a Multipass/Virtualization VM is running in the background and eating most of system RAM. If npm run build or tsc --noEmit seem hung with no output for several minutes, check top/memory_pressure before assuming a code problem.
